$comment: Topic pool for the daily infographic routine (scripts/daily-infographics.mjs).
Each entry produces one en/es infographic pair and is then marked used, so a
topic is never published twice. Add new entries to the end; order does not
matter, the routine picks the first unused one.
Every bullet is a horticultural claim that goes out unreviewed, so treat this
file the way STYLE.md treats article copy: correct advice, no invented numbers,
no statistics. Keep bullets to about six words — the card geometry in
scripts/lib/infographic.mjs is sized for two short bullets per step, and the QA
pass fails the build rather than shipping clipped text.
icon.slug must either exist in public/assets/icons/ or carry a `subject`, which
the routine uses to generate it once and add it to the shared library.

en.title: How to Grow Tomatoes: A Beginner's Guide in 8 Steps
en.description: Eight steps to a productive tomato plant, from picking a variety through to knowing when the fruit is actually ready.
en.pinDescription: How to grow tomatoes from planting to harvest: pick the right variety, plant the stem deep for stronger roots, water at the base, and pick at full colour. A save-and-keep guide for the vegetable garden.
en.cta: Plan your beds with Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Pro tip
proTip.text: Mulch two to three inches around each plant. It holds moisture, blocks weeds, and stops the soil splash that spreads disease onto the lower leaves.

steps.label: Plant Deep
bullets: Bury two thirds of the stem

es.description: Ocho pasos para una tomatera productiva, desde elegir la variedad hasta saber cuándo el fruto está listo.
es.pinDescription: Cómo cultivar tomates desde la siembra hasta la cosecha: elige bien la variedad, entierra el tallo para que eche más raíces, riega en la base y recoge con color pleno. Una guía para guardar.
es.cta: Planifica tu huerto con Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Consejo
proTip.text: Cubre con cinco a ocho centímetros de acolchado. Retiene la humedad, frena las malas hierbas y evita las salpicaduras de tierra que llevan enfermedades a las hojas bajas.

steps.label: Pleno Sol
bullets: De seis a ocho horas diarias

steps.label: Riego Constante
bullets: Riega la base, no las hojas

steps.label: Abona Seguido
bullets: Abono bajo en nitrógeno al florecer

en.title: How to Grow Strawberries: 8 Steps to a Real Harvest
en.description: What strawberry plants actually need, from crown depth at planting through to keeping the fruit off wet soil.
en.pinDescription: How to grow strawberries at home: set the crown level with the soil, give them full sun, mulch under the fruit, and pinch the first flowers so the plant roots properly. A save-and-keep guide.
en.cta: Track your harvest in Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Pro tip
proTip.text: Pinch off the first flush of flowers on a new plant. You lose a few early berries and get a far stronger plant, and a much bigger crop, for the rest of the season.

steps.label: Manage Runners

es.title: Cómo Cultivar Fresas: 8 Pasos para una Buena Cosecha
es.description: Lo que de verdad necesitan las fresas, desde la profundidad de la corona hasta mantener el fruto lejos de la tierra húmeda.
es.pinDescription: Cómo cultivar fresas en casa: deja la corona al nivel del suelo, dales pleno sol, pon acolchado bajo el fruto y pellizca las primeras flores para que la planta arraigue. Guía para guardar.
es.cta: Registra tu cosecha en Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Consejo
proTip.text: Pellizca la primera floración de una planta nueva. Pierdes unas pocas fresas tempranas y ganas una planta mucho más fuerte, con más cosecha durante el resto de la temporada.

en.title: How to Grow Basil That Doesn't Bolt in a Month
en.description: Eight steps to a bushy basil plant, and the pinching habit that keeps it producing instead of running to seed.
en.pinDescription: How to grow basil that stays bushy: pinch above a leaf pair to force branching, keep it warm, water the soil rather than the leaves, and remove flower buds as they appear. A save-and-keep herb guide.
en.cta: Plan your herb bed in Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Pro tip
proTip.text: Pinch the growing tip once the plant has two or three sets of true leaves, and keep pinching every couple of weeks. Each cut turns one stem into two, and a pinched plant stays productive far longer.

steps.label: Water the Soil
bullets: Water when the top feels dry

steps.label: Pinch the Tips
bullets: Cut above a pair of leaves

steps.label: Remove Flower Buds
bullets: Pinch buds the day you see them

steps.label: Feed Lightly
bullets: Too much feed thins the flavour

steps.label: Harvest from the Top

es.title: Cómo Cultivar Albahaca sin que se Suba a Flor
es.description: Ocho pasos para una albahaca frondosa, y el pellizco que la mantiene produciendo en vez de subirse a flor.
es.pinDescription: Cómo cultivar albahaca frondosa: pellizca sobre un par de hojas para que ramifique, mantenla en calor, riega la tierra y no las hojas, y quita los botones florales en cuanto aparezcan.
es.cta: Planifica tus hierbas en Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Consejo
proTip.text: Pellizca la punta cuando la planta tenga dos o tres pares de hojas verdaderas, y repite cada dos semanas. Cada corte convierte un tallo en dos, y una planta pellizcada produce mucho más tiempo.

en.title: How to Grow Sunflowers from Seed in 8 Steps
en.description: Sowing depth, spacing, staking and when to cut, for sunflowers that stand up through a summer storm.
en.pinDescription: How to grow sunflowers from seed: sow direct rather than transplanting, give tall varieties a stake before they need it, and cut for the vase as the first petals lift. A save-and-keep flower guide.
en.cta: Plan your flower beds in Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Pro tip
proTip.text: Sow a short row every two weeks from spring through midsummer instead of all at once. You get sunflowers in bloom for months rather than one spectacular fortnight and then bare stalks.

es.description: Profundidad de siembra, marco, tutorado y momento de corte, para girasoles que aguanten una tormenta de verano.
es.pinDescription: Cómo cultivar girasoles desde semilla: siembra directa en vez de trasplantar, pon tutor a las variedades altas antes de que lo necesiten, y corta cuando los primeros pétalos se levanten.

proTip.label: Consejo
proTip.text: Siembra una hilera corta cada dos semanas desde la primavera hasta mediados de verano en lugar de todo de golpe. Así tendrás girasoles en flor durante meses y no quince días espectaculares.

en.title: How to Plant a Fruit Tree So It Actually Establishes
en.chartTitle: How to plant a fruit tree
en.description: Hole width, graft height, watering and the two mistakes that kill more young fruit trees than anything else.
en.pinDescription: How to plant a fruit tree properly: dig wide rather than deep, keep the graft union above the soil, skip the fertiliser in the hole, and water deeply through the first two summers.
en.cta: Map your orchard in Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Pro tip
proTip.text: Most young fruit trees are lost in their first two summers, and almost always to drought rather than cold. One long slow soak a week through dry spells beats a daily sprinkle every time.

steps.label: Skip the Fertiliser
bullets: No feed in the planting hole

steps.label: Backfill and Firm
bullets: Use the soil you dug out

es.title: Cómo Plantar un Árbol Frutal para que Arraigue de Verdad
es.description: Ancho del hoyo, altura del injerto, riego y los dos errores que matan más frutales jóvenes que ninguna otra cosa.
es.pinDescription: Cómo plantar bien un árbol frutal: cava ancho y no profundo, deja el injerto por encima de la tierra, no eches abono en el hoyo y riega a fondo durante los dos primeros veranos.
es.cta: Planifica tu huerto en Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Consejo
proTip.text: La mayoría de los frutales jóvenes se pierden en sus dos primeros veranos, y casi siempre por sequía y no por frío. Un riego largo y lento por semana en épocas secas vale más que un rociado diario.

en.title: How to Grow Carrots That Aren't Forked and Stubby
en.description: Why carrots fork, why they never come up, and the thinning most gardeners skip and then regret.
en.pinDescription: How to grow straight carrots: loosen deep stone-free soil, sow direct and shallow, keep the seedbed damp until germination, and thin properly. A save-and-keep root vegetable guide.
en.cta: Plan your rows in Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Pro tip
proTip.text: Carrot seed is tiny and needs constant moisture to germinate, which is the usual reason a row never comes up. Cover the row with a board or damp cloth and check daily, lifting it the moment green shows.

bullets: Dig a foot down, stone free

steps.label: Keep Soil Damp

es.title: Cómo Cultivar Zanahorias Rectas y no Bifurcadas
es.description: Por qué se bifurcan, por qué a veces no nacen, y el aclareo que casi todo el mundo se salta y luego lamenta.
es.pinDescription: Cómo cultivar zanahorias rectas: mulle la tierra profunda y sin piedras, siembra directa y superficial, mantén el semillero húmedo hasta que nazcan, y aclara bien.
es.cta: Planifica tus hileras en Garden Pro Planner

proTip.label: Consejo
proTip.text: La semilla de zanahoria es diminuta y necesita humedad constante para germinar, que es la razón habitual de que una hilera no nazca. Tapa la línea con una tabla o un paño húmedo y revísala a diario.
